address_semantics: Preferred addresses only. Separate loader CODE and DATA domains; these numbers are not relocated runtime pointers.

_gz_hx_index.contract: Existing indexR2/runtimeR3 cache; all genuine writers must maintain it under the same lock.

_gz_hx_select_allocation.contract: Existing ordinary C (pointer,heap,create=0)->HxRow*; first pointer+heap before EMPTY, before downstream state checks.

_gz_hx_cursor_begin.contract: Existing ordinary C (index,pointer,owned32Bcursor)->status; no native allocation lease.

_gz_hx_cursor_next.contract: Existing ordinary C (index,rows,owned32Bcursor,owned4BrowID)->status; index and primary rows stable under retained common lock.

_gz_hl_control.contract: Existing HL control; original common lock already owned, busy==1.

_gz_hl_allocations.contract: Existing primary metadata rows only; no pointed-to payload is read.

_gz_hx_release_begin_found.contract: Unlinked continuation in original Begin frame; r7 HL control and nonvolatile state retained; found also r9 row.

_gz_hx_release_begin_missing.contract: Unlinked continuation in original Begin frame; r7 HL control and nonvolatile state retained; found also r9 row.

_gz_hx_release_return_found.contract: Unlinked continuation in original Return frame; r4/r5/r6 and r31 token retained; found also r9 row and r3 ENDING.

_gz_hx_release_return_missing.contract: Unlinked continuation in original Return frame; r4/r5/r6 and r31 token retained; found also r9 row and r3 ENDING.

_gz_hx_existing_ready.contract: Static ordinary C ready(void)->u32; exact entry derived from the existing selector call, not a public SDK interface.

entry_contracts.begin: Original function entry 0x02a9ecf0,32B frame; hook after original lock and EXP/UNIT admission. Inputs r28 pointer,r31 heap,r7 HL control.
entry_contracts.return_: Original function entry 0x02a9efc8,24B frame; token0 exits before hook; otherwise hook after original lock/counter. Inputs r4 pointer,r5 HL control,r6 heap,r31 token.

integration_requirements: Authenticate actual parent RPX hash, original hook owners and complete Native continuation live-ins before installing any branch.
Resolve all 11 interfaces from genuine typed parent rows/exports and provider bodies. Do not infer CODE/DATA placement from numeric addresses.
PPC REL24 kind10 uses CODE bias; ADDR16_HA kind6 plus ADDR16_LO kind4 use target DATA bias including signed-low carry. Keep source relocation addends.
Install unlinked hook branches only after component placement/range and loader-row proof; no full RPX builder is included.
Full-kit/AD composition moves existing provider CODE by +4 relative to this parent. This catalogue MUST NOT be used there without separate actual-parent byte/typed binding proof; do not add4 blindly.
